localised_description: A general's horse can be their most trusted and daring companion. Just don't name him 'Daisy'.
Once trained to carry a man in battle, Imperial griffons are poised killers and incredibly dedicated to their riders.
This Lord belts out orders and can be heard even across a battlefield smothered in the grim noise of war.
The relentless drive and fury of the Hammer, harnessed for the protection of this ward’s bearer.
Their renown shall further elevate the one under whose command they march.
Who wants to live forever? As it turns out, most beings wouldn't say no…
Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.
A veteran of countless battles, this one has a hunger for slaughter and a thirst for blood.
One doesn't reach the rank of General without having survived many a battle.
This one's many courageous deeds are celebrated far and wide across the Empire, with many speaking of their might and determination in the very thick of battle.
The blades of the Empire slice through the enemy like so many knives through so much fleshy butter.
Courage, duty, honour – all meaningless without discipline. This commander demands their troops be perfectly drilled, that they may stand fast against even the darkest of the Empire's foes.
With their general at its head, the Empire's cavalry charge into battle with great zeal.
Having friends in the high places of Imperial society has its benefits. It's always *who* you know...
This one is loved and respected by their troops, many of whom have come from all over the world to fight at their side.
{{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh_main_skill_all_all_self_hard_to_hit}}
{{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh_main_skill_all_all_self_devastating_charge}}
Full-Plate armour protects the wearer from head-to-foot. Many such suits are blessed or imbued with arcane abilities.
{{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh_main_skill_all_all_self_scarred_veteran}}
A deadly blade is especially lethal when in the hands of this master death-maker, killer and slaughterer!
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
{{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh_main_skill_all_all_self_wound-maker}}
{{tr:character_skills_localised_description_wh_main_skill_all_all_self_blade_master}}
The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.
A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.
The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.
There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.
“We march to war for our Emperor, and Sigmar, our saviour and lord.”
These steeds are bred for speed and war, but foremost it is their gallop which marks them out.
This Lord expects his men to practice the disciplines of the Pistolkorps, and all be expert marksmen.
Harnessed for war, these great beasts have proven themselves as loyal and powerful champions on the battlefield.
Patrons of great forges and smiths expect, and are rewarded with, tougher and more enduring war machines.
Despite what the Dwarfs think, no other race can bring to bear such devastating artillery volleys.
The frontline will either make or break you. Those who survive become the backbone of any army.
The veteran marksman knows the precise range required to land the killing shot.
Some men grow to relish war, dulled to the pain and living solely for the thrill of the kill.
Those in command of ordnance can potentially decide a battle before the melee has even begun.
Those who know the land and its secrets will travel faster and further than the foes who don't.
This Lord expects utter obedience from the smallfolk, and has little time for insurrections or petty revolts.
Revered by the masses, such a celebrated leader will inspire many new recruits.
The presence of this Lord ensures a measure of calm, reducing panic and desertion amongst followers.
Through our acts, the gods will cleanse the lands.
It is said that Sigmar would bear a mortal wound and carry on fighting; this champion follows the hallowed Warrior-God.
The time to strike is now!
A good quartermaster can ration equipment and foodstuffs efficiently, making supplies last longer.
Proficient with figures, this Lord, or his subordinates, can keep his army fulfilled, even in dire circumstances.
Countless conflicts and a keen sense of awareness have made this Lord difficult to entrap.
Ever thought about joining the Elector's troops, chief? You'd make a good soldier alright.
As a guardian, the Warrioress is sworn to protect everything that Asur hold dear.
